resources.string: Permission needed to find contacts that should not be blocked

Allows the app to request disabling the battery optimizations. This permission is useful, but not strictly necessary for the app functions, since it is possible to disable optimizations via the system configurations.
Permission needed to be able to block calls. A dialog will be displayed asking to choose this app as your default call screening app.
With battery optimizations enabled, the app can be interrupted at any moment, disrupting the app ability to block calls.
